relations.note: Cloacina was cultically identified with or absorbed into Venus under a purificatory title.
relations.source: Mussidius coinage; Pliny 15.119; Servius on Aeneid 1.720

relations.note: Concordia appears on the obverse while Cloacina's shrine appears on the reverse.
Sol appears on the obverse of a related coin depicting Cloacina's shrine.
Edmund Curll invokes Jove and Cloacina together during Pope's mock-heroic contest.
Prudentius juxtaposes Cloacina and Epona as supposedly low or local goddesses.
